chunks: From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Yazid Al-Bahraani, from Abdur-Razzaq ibn Hammam, from Muammar, from Ibn Tawus, from Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Abbas, who said:
The Mahdi will not emerge until a sign rises with the Sun.

key_terms.الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Mahdi, the awaited guided one

ai.seo_question: What is the sign that must appear with the Sun before the Mahdi emerges?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Ghayba highlights a specific cosmic sign preceding the reappearance of Imam Al-Mahdi (a.s.), where a miraculous phenomenon emerges alongside the Sun. In Shia eschatology, this 'sign' (ayah) is often interpreted as a visible celestial event or a specific astronomical occurrence that serves as a divine confirmation for the world before the Imam's final emergence. This aligns with the broader theme of divine signs in the Quran that mark the transition between ages and the establishment of justice.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 482 - It is narrated from Abbas bin Yazid Bahrani from Abdur Razzaq bin Hammam from Muammar from Ibn Tawus from Ali bin Abdullah bin Abbas that he said: “
The Mahdi will not reappear till a sign appears with the Sun.”
